data.one_liner: Renders <iframe> tags in flutter_html using webview_flutter.
data.what_it_does: This package provides an IframeHtmlExtension that lets flutter_html render <iframe> elements via the webview_flutter plugin. It respects width, height, and sandbox attributes and allows a navigationDelegate to control URL loading.
use_when: You need to display iframe content inside a flutter_html widget.
You want sandboxed or unrestricted JavaScript control for the iframe.
You need to block or allow navigation within the iframe via a delegate.
avoid_when: You are targeting web only, as webview_flutter is not supported on web.
You do not need iframe support in your HTML rendering.
strengths: Supports sandbox and navigationDelegate for security and control.
weaknesses: Only works on platforms supported by webview_flutter (Android, iOS, macOS).
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_html_iframe to pubspec, import, and register IframeHtmlExtension in Html widget.
